description: Cross-region DR failover drill: promote the us-west-2 read replica to primary, verify application functionality against the new primary, run full integration tests, then failback to us-east-1 primary and verify split-brain protection. Must: lower DNS TTL to 60s, promote replica, update connection strings, verify data consistency, monitor for write conflicts, then failback with reverse replication. Risk factors: replication lag causing data loss during promotion, split-brain if both regions accept writes, DNS caching delaying failover, failback replication not re-established. Tools available: aws RDS, Route53, ansible, psql, Prometheus.
